test_callback_invocation: test passing Python functions, lambdas, and partials as callbacks to C++ via pybind11 bindings
test_bound_method_callback: test passing bound Python and C++ methods as callbacks to pybind11 C++ functions
test_keyword_args_unpacking: test tuple unpacking, dict unpacking, and keyword argument passing in pybind11 callbacks
test_lambda_closure_cleanup: test that C++ properly cleans up Python lambda closures and verify construction statistics
test_cpp_function_roundtrip: test that function pointers roundtrip correctly from C++ to Python and back to C++
